title: fix(headless): bound tool-child hold + route /clear through clear_session_context
context:
A worker-owned Claude spawn's queued-input gate treated a live tool
child as an unbounded busy signal, so a stuck background command (a
long-running `npx vercel deploy`, in the field) held every later
message queued ("sending…") long after the enclosing turn had actually
finished. Also, a queued "/clear" was written to the FIFO as literal
text — Claude executes it, but CCC never re-keyed the spawn/UI to the
fresh post-clear session, so the conversation went dead.

- worker_engines.py: input_stat
decision: Changed code in server.py, tests/test_smoke.py, worker_engines.py (3 file(s)).
